body.purpose: Dense control labels and application copy.

label.purpose: Toolbar groups, overlines, and compact metadata labels.

shadows.name: table-header
shadows.purpose: Separate column headers from scrolling log rows.

shadows.name: toolbar
shadows.purpose: Lift the grouped filter bar above the workspace.

shadows.name: persistent-region
shadows.purpose: Separate sidebar and tab strip from content.

shadows.name: popup
shadows.purpose: Place transient cell-value and tooltip surfaces above content.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: A compact signal-cyan action for the most important command in a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #007ACC; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 13px/16px sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00A3E0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Welcome card
components.description: A centered source-entry card for the empty workspace state.
components.css: .ds-welcome-card { width: 200px; padding: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #F5F5F5; color: #121212; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.18); text-align: center; } .ds-welcome-card:hover { background: #EBEBEB; } .ds-welcome-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007ACC; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-welcome-card__title { display: block; font: 700 14px/18px sans-serif; } .ds-welcome-card__description { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: rgba(18,18,18,.6); font: 400 11px/15px sans-serif; }

components.name: Filter bar
components.description: A grouped command surface for source, stream, view, overflow, and filter actions.
components.css: .ds-filter-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; min-height: 32px; border-radius: 4px; background: #F5F5F5; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.16); font: 500 10px/12px sans-serif; letter-spacing: .5px; } .ds-filter-bar__group { padding: 4px 8px; color: #121212; } .ds-filter-bar__group:hover { background: rgba(0,122,204,.1); border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview: KLogViewer is a dense and precise operations console. Industrial dark and clean light surfaces keep attention on high-volume log data, while signal cyan and semantic severity colors communicate action and state.
keyCharacteristics: Signal cyan and semantic severity colors

rules.name: The Signal Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Use weight, spacing, and semantic color to clarify operational state; never decorate merely to fill space.

rules.name: The Layered Workspace Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces first and elevation second; every lifted surface must clarify a workspace layer or interaction.

dos: Do keep the log table visually dominant.
Do organize toolbar actions into labeled groups.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism or ornamental gradients.
Don't use status colors as decoration.
